description: This file defines a helper class ApiTokenHelper for generating JWT tokens for test users (admin and normal user) in integration tests. It constructs tokens with specific claims, expiration, and signing credentials, used for authentication in API testing scenarios.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with admin user roles for testing.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with normal user roles for testing.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token given a username and roles, including setting claims, signing credentials, and expiration.
